title: NFC Epoxy Key Tag — Custom Die-Cut Resin-Domed Tag
summary: NFC epoxy key tags seal a 13.56 MHz HF inlay under a UV-stable clear epoxy dome on a CMYK-printed PVC / PET face. Each tag is die-cut to any custom silhouette and carries {chip:nxp-ntag-213:short_name} / 215 / 216 / 424 DNA or {chip:nxp-mifare-desfire-ev3:short_name}. The outdoor dome passes ISO 4892-2 weathering (1,000 h, ΔE ≤ 2); housings rate IP65 or IP67 per IEC 60529. A 316L stainless split ring passes EN 1811 nickel release.

brief.label: Form factor + die-cut envelope
items: Standard shapes — round Ø 30 / 35 / 40 mm, rectangular 25 × 45 mm, oval 25 × 40 mm, square 30 × 30 mm, 3-5 mm overall thickness including the self-levelling epoxy dome.
Custom die-cut silhouette — logo / mascot / product outline at ±0.3 mm contour tolerance, one-time tooling fee, 1,000-piece MOQ.
Two-sided print option — CMYK artwork on front + back with single or dual epoxy dome; one-time plate cost on the second side.

brief.label: Epoxy-resin chemistry + weathering
items: Clear thermosetting epoxy (bisphenol-A + aliphatic-amine cure) self-levels to a 0.8-1.5 mm dome above the printed face at 23 °C cure envelope.
Outdoor-rated epoxy formulation passes ISO 4892-2 xenon-arc weathering at 1,000 h accelerated exposure with ΔE ≤ 2 colour-shift and zero visible crazing / yellowing.
Indoor-default formulation is acceptable for pocket / purse carry but shifts visibly yellow after 6-12 months of sustained sunlight — upcharge to outdoor grade is 8-12 % of unit cost.

brief.label: Air-interface envelope
items: 13.56 MHz HF per ISO/IEC 14443-3 ({chip:nxp-ntag-213:short_name} / 215 / 216 / 424 DNA; {chip:nxp-mifare-classic-1k:short_name}; {chip:nxp-mifare-desfire-ev3:short_name}; I-CODE SLIX2).
Read range 0-30 mm at typical smartphone / POS reader tune; the epoxy dome does not attenuate the 13.56 MHz carrier — the antenna is coupled through the dielectric dome without loss.
NFC Forum Type 2 ({chip:nxp-ntag-213:short_name} / 215 / 216) NDEF envelope for phone-tappable URL / vCard / Wi-Fi handover; NFC Forum Type 4 Tag envelope for DESFire EV3 AES-128 session payloads.

brief.label: On-chip memory + security posture
items: {chip:nxp-ntag-213:short_name} — 144 bytes user memory, NFC Forum Type 2, UID read-only; the correct choice for tap-to-URL / tap-to-vCard consumer-loyalty and social-sharing payloads.
{chip:nxp-ntag-216:short_name} — 888 bytes user memory for larger NDEF payloads (multi-record vCard + product-passport JSON + URL); same phone-tappable posture as {chip:nxp-ntag-213:short_name}.

{chip:nxp-ntag-424-dna:short_name} — SUN (Secure Unique NFC) message with CMAC per NIST SP 800-38B for tap-authenticated loyalty / anti-counterfeit / ticketing; SUN URL is verified server-side before the payload is honoured.

{chip:nxp-mifare-classic-1k:short_name} — CRYPTO-1 cipher has been publicly broken since Garcia et al. 2008; NXP and the German BSI both recommend migration away from CRYPTO-1 for new high-value deployments; retained for drop-in parity with legacy HF reader estates only.
{chip:nxp-mifare-desfire-ev3:short_name} — AES-128 mutual authentication + session keys per NXP AN12343 + NXP AN10922 key-diversification, for high-security membership / cashless-loyalty rollouts.

brief.label: Ingress + mechanical durability
items: IP65 per IEC 60529 on the single-dome variant — dust-tight, protected against low-pressure water jets, acceptable for rain / hand-wash / sweat.
IP67 per IEC 60529 on the fully-domed variant (epoxy covers front and back) — acceptable for temporary immersion (1 m / 30 minutes).
Drop survival — the cured epoxy dome resists typical key-ring 1-1.5 m drop on tile / concrete without cracking; chip EEPROM unaffected.

brief.label: Split-ring + attachment hardware
items: Stainless-steel 316L split ring (Ø 25-32 mm, 50 N pull-strength) standard for fitness / pool / outdoor carry — passes EN 1811 nickel release at ≤ 0.5 µg/cm²/week and REACH Annex XVII entry 27.
Nickel-plated split ring available on indoor-only consumer-promotional SKUs at lower unit cost; not recommended for chlorine / saltwater / sweat-heavy carry.
Lobster-claw clasp + ball-chain + silicone lanyard alternatives — attachment hardware is de-coupled from tag SKU and is selectable per rollout.

brief.label: Consumer-loyalty + social posture
items: Die-cut mascot / logo silhouette becomes the hero object of the loyalty programme — the tap-to-earn credential that guests photograph and share on social media as an organic brand impression.
{chip:nxp-ntag-424-dna:short_name} SUN URL + UID fingerprint supports tap-authenticated loyalty-points credit with per-tap counter and server-side replay protection; CMAC hash per NIST SP 800-38B.

URL / vCard / Wi-Fi handover / Instagram / LinkedIn / TikTok NDEF records encode cleanly on {chip:nxp-ntag-213:short_name} / 216 without re-issuing the tag — the same physical tag follows the member across campaign seasons.

brief.label: Pet-ID + outdoor-souvenir posture
items: Pet-ID epoxy tag — bone / paw / heart silhouette, fully-domed IP67 for outdoor + pool + hose-wash; owner-contact URL or ICE vCard encoded on {chip:nxp-ntag-216:short_name} memory slot.

Resort / theme-park / national-park souvenir tag — die-cut mascot silhouette with {chip:nxp-ntag-213:short_name} URL to the park website or digital trail map; printed limited-edition serial number on the PVC face.
Outdoor-rated epoxy + 316L split ring is mandatory for pet-collar and outdoor-souvenir rollouts — indoor-default epoxy yellows inside 6 months of daily sun exposure.

brief.label: Access-control + membership posture
items: {chip:nxp-mifare-desfire-ev3:short_name} epoxy key tag for boutique fitness / co-working / members-club access-control credentials — AES-128 mutual authentication into Wiegand 34 / OSDP v2.2 reader estates.

Chip compatibility verified against the specific reader brand + model before the artwork is frozen — buyers send the reader make / model and Proud Tek confirms the chip in writing; this step prevents the 500-piece unusable-tag outcome that happens when chip and reader are mismatched.

Revocation at the PACS is the actual security control — revoke-on-loss happens at the head-end within seconds of the HRIS / member-management trigger, regardless of whether the physical tag is recovered.

brief.label: Regulatory + disclosure envelope
items: RoHS 3 (EU 2015/863) + REACH SVHC screen on the epoxy resin, CMYK ink, PVC / PET face stock, adhesive layer and split-ring plating.
FCC Part 15.225 (13.56 MHz) and ISED RSS-210 / RSS-GEN — the tag is a passive HF transponder paired with a reader that carries the FCC / ISED ID.
California Proposition 65 declaration for the CMYK ink + epoxy resin where the tag SKU is distributed into the California consumer channel.
EN 71-3 migration of certain elements (for consumer-facing children's novelty tag variants) and EU Toy Safety Directive 2009/48/EC — declared per SKU where the artwork targets a children's channel.

brief.label: End-of-life + disposal
items: Epoxy resin + PVC face + NFC inlay separation is mechanical — cut the tag to expose the inlay, chip, and copper antenna for the WEEE-stream, and recycle the 316L split ring into the metal stream.
UID / memory sanitisation per NIST SP 800-88 Rev. 1 when the tag housed a revocable membership credential — destroy the chip before disposal to close the physical-security audit.
Halogen-free PET face stock + lead-free 316L split ring available on request for corporate CDP / Higg Index sustainability reporting.

heroPoints: Custom die-cut silhouette at ±0.3 mm contour tolerance with UV-stable ISO 4892-2 epoxy dome — the loyalty / pet-ID / souvenir NFC tag that members photograph, share and carry for years.

NFC Forum Type 2 ({chip:nxp-ntag-213:short_name} / 215 / 216) phone-tappable envelope for URL / vCard / social-handover payloads + {chip:nxp-ntag-424-dna:short_name} SUN + {chip:nxp-mifare-desfire-ev3:short_name} AES-128 for access-control + anti-counterfeit rollouts.

IP65 single-dome / IP67 fully-domed per IEC 60529 with 316L stainless split ring cleared under EN 1811 nickel release — the outdoor + pool + chlorine + sweat carry envelope that indoor-only epoxy + nickel-plated rings cannot match.

sections.title: Why epoxy-domed NFC key tags win where flat printed tags fail
bullets: Clear cured epoxy acts as a dielectric lens over the CMYK artwork. Colours look deeper and more saturated through the dome than on a flat print, turning the tag into a keepsake the member wants to carry rather than a disposable credential.

ISO 4892-2 xenon-arc-weathered epoxy holds colour (ΔE ≤ 2) through 1,000 h accelerated UV exposure. The indoor-default grade yellows visibly at 6-12 months of pocket-and-daylight carry, so outdoor / pet / resort SKUs must specify the outdoor grade upfront.
±0.3 mm die-cut contour tolerance on custom silhouettes is the finish-quality bar. A 2-3 mm PVC margin visible around a logo die-cut is the defect signal that telegraphs a cheaper supplier.

316L stainless split ring (EN 1811 Ni-release ≤ 0.5 µg/cm²/week, REACH Annex XVII entry 27) is the default for fitness / pool / outdoor rollouts. Nickel-plated split rings corrode in 2-3 months under chlorine / sweat and generate customer-service tickets.

MOQ tiers — 500-piece on standard round / rectangular / oval (no tooling fee); 1,000-piece on custom die-cut silhouettes (one-time tooling fee). The tiering keeps boutique-venue pilot rollouts in reach without compromising the premium finish.

sections.title: Chip-family + artwork layer — picking what goes under the dome
bullets: {chip:nxp-ntag-213:short_name} (144 bytes) — entry-level tap-to-URL / tap-to-vCard consumer-loyalty / digital-business-card / social-media-handover payloads. UID read-only, phone-tappable on every iOS 13 + and Android NFC handset.

{chip:nxp-ntag-216:short_name} (888 bytes) — larger NDEF envelope (multi-record vCard + product-passport JSON + rich URL), same phone-tappable posture as {chip:nxp-ntag-213:short_name}, preferred for EU ESPR digital-product-passport continuation.

{chip:nxp-ntag-424-dna:short_name} — SUN (Secure Unique NFC) message with CMAC per NIST SP 800-38B, for tap-authenticated loyalty / anti-counterfeit / ticketing where replay protection + server-side verification matter.

{chip:nxp-mifare-desfire-ev3:short_name} — AES-128 mutual authentication + session keys per NXP AN12343 + NXP AN10922 key-diversification, for boutique fitness / co-working / members-club access-control credentials.

{chip:nxp-mifare-classic-1k:short_name} — retained only for drop-in parity with legacy HF reader estates. CRYPTO-1 is publicly broken (Garcia 2008) and the NXP + BSI migration guidance is explicit, so new-build rollouts should skip straight to DESFire EV3 or {chip:nxp-ntag-424-dna:short_name}.

Artwork layer — CMYK digital print on PVC 76 µ / PET 125 µ face stock under the dome. UV-curable CMYK ink is standard for outdoor rollouts and resists the same ISO 4892-2 xenon-arc window as the outdoor epoxy grade.

sections.title: Where NFC epoxy key tags earn their place in the catalogue
bullets: Boutique fitness / members club — 500-1,500 branded epoxy tags per programme. {chip:nxp-mifare-desfire-ev3:short_name} chip into Wiegand 34 / OSDP v2.2 reader; outdoor-grade epoxy + 316L ring + die-cut club-logo silhouette.

Hospitality / resort / theme park — 5,000-50,000 souvenir tags per season. {chip:nxp-ntag-213:short_name} URL pointing to the park mascot page or digital trail map; limited-edition serial-numbered artwork.

Pet-ID — bone / paw / heart silhouette, fully-domed IP67 for hose-wash + rain + snow carry. Owner-contact URL or ICE vCard encoded on {chip:nxp-ntag-216:short_name}; 316L ring for the collar attachment.

Digital business card / networking — {chip:nxp-ntag-213:short_name} / 216 SKU encoded with the member's vCard + LinkedIn + Instagram URLs. Dropped into the pocket / handbag as the tap-to-share credential.
Loyalty / cashback / tap-to-earn — {chip:nxp-ntag-424-dna:short_name} SUN URL into the retailer's POS for server-side verified per-tap points credit. CMAC replay protection per NIST SP 800-38B.
Brand merchandise / corporate-gift / trade-show giveaway — die-cut mascot silhouette becomes the hero giveaway item. NDEF URL pre-programmed to the landing page with UTM tracking.

sections.title: How to roll out an NFC epoxy key tag programme without finish-quality surprises
bullets: Freeze the die-cut silhouette + CMYK artwork + chip family before tooling. A logo die-cut with ±0.3 mm tolerance must be approved from a physical sample, not only a digital proof, because the dome-to-contour geometry reads differently in resin.

Specify outdoor-grade epoxy + UV-curable CMYK ink + 316L split ring from the start for any pet / resort / fitness / outdoor rollout. The indoor-default grade yellows inside 6-12 months of sustained daylight and the nickel-plated ring corrodes inside 2-3 months under chlorine.

Confirm chip compatibility against the specific reader brand + model in writing before artwork is frozen. A mismatched chip on 500 finished tags is the single biggest finish-quality trap. Proud Tek cross-references the compatibility matrix against the reader make at the RFQ stage.

Plan the NDEF payload before encoding — URL / vCard / Wi-Fi handover / loyalty-SUN can all coexist on {chip:nxp-ntag-216:short_name} memory. {chip:nxp-ntag-424-dna:short_name} SUN + CMAC requires server-side endpoint up before the first tag ships.

Sustain posture — halogen-free PET face stock + 316L ring + RoHS 3 + REACH SVHC evidence pack + California Prop 65 declaration feed the programme's CDP / Higg Index / sustainability reporting envelope.

items.label: Week 1 — silhouette + chip freeze
items.text: Finalise die-cut silhouette (standard round / rectangular / oval, or custom logo / mascot outline with one-time tooling fee), CMYK artwork, chip family ({chip:nxp-ntag-213:short_name} / 216 / 424 DNA / DESFire EV3), and epoxy grade (indoor-default vs ISO 4892-2 outdoor). Confirm reader brand + model against the chip compatibility matrix in writing.

items.label: Weeks 2-3 — physical sample + NDEF payload validation
items.text: Produce 5-10 physical samples across the chosen chip + epoxy + die-cut envelope; validate NDEF / DESFire AES authentication on the reader make + model; tap-test on iOS 13 + / Android handsets; approve the contour tolerance against the artwork.

items.label: Weeks 4-6 — production run + finish-quality audit
items.text: Run the 500-50,000-piece production batch; audit 1 % QC sample against die-cut contour (±0.3 mm), dome optical clarity, ring-attachment pull (50 N), NFC read-rate (100 % UID + 99.5 %+ NDEF); reject any batch that fails the finish-quality bar.

items.label: Weeks 7-8 — encoding + logistics
items.text: Stand up the encoding bench tied to the loyalty / PACS / member-management endpoint; pre-encode NDEF URL / SUN / AES-128 session credentials; polybag + retail-packaging per rollout channel; ship to the venue / brand warehouse.

items.label: Month 3+ — audit cadence + sustainability reporting
items.text: Programme references draw from boutique-fitness, hospitality-loyalty, pet-ID, digital-business-card, tap-to-earn-loyalty and brand-merchandise NFC-epoxy-key-tag estates, with periodic compliance reviews, refresh-cycle planning and supplier-onboarding gates customised per vertical. wire issue / revoke / replace events into the member-management audit log; layer RoHS 3 + REACH SVHC + California Prop 65 + EN 1811 evidence into the CDP / Higg Index reporting feed.

faq.question: How durable is the epoxy dome against keychain scratches and UV fading?
faq.answer: The outdoor-grade epoxy formulation passes ISO 4892-2 xenon-arc weathering at 1,000 h accelerated exposure with ΔE ≤ 2 colour shift and zero visible crazing or yellowing — this maps to 3-5 years of typical outdoor pocket-and-daylight carry. The cured resin resists keychain scratches (typical dome hardness > Shore D 80) and survives 1-1.5 m drop onto tile / concrete without cracking. The NFC chip inside is fully encapsulated and is not affected by mechanical or UV exposure. The indoor-default grade is acceptable for pocket carry but shifts yellow inside 6-12 months of sustained daylight — for any pet / resort / fitness / outdoor rollout, specify the outdoor grade at quote time (8-12 % unit-cost upcharge).

faq.question: Can I get a completely custom die-cut shape?
faq.answer: Yes — a custom die-cut silhouette matching any logo, mascot, product outline or brand icon is produced at ±0.3 mm contour tolerance. Custom dies carry a one-time tooling fee and a 1,000-piece MOQ. Standard shapes (round Ø 30 / 35 / 40 mm, rectangular 25 × 45 mm, oval 25 × 40 mm, square 30 × 30 mm) are available from 500 pieces with no tooling fee. A physical sample is produced and approved before the full production run begins, eliminating the 2-3 mm PVC-margin defect that signals a cheap supplier.

faq.question: What NFC chip should I specify for my rollout?
faq.answer: For tap-to-URL / tap-to-vCard / tap-to-social consumer-loyalty payloads — NTAG 213 ({chip:nxp-ntag-213:user_bytes} bytes) or NTAG 216 ({chip:nxp-ntag-216:user_bytes} bytes), both phone-tappable on every iOS 13 + and Android NFC handset. For tap-authenticated loyalty / anti-counterfeit / ticketing with replay protection — NTAG 424 DNA with the SUN message + CMAC per NIST SP 800-38B. For access-control membership credentials — MIFARE DESFire EV3 with AES-128 mutual authentication per NXP AN12343 + NXP AN10922 key-diversification. MIFARE Classic 1K is available for drop-in parity with legacy HF reader estates, but the CRYPTO-1 cipher has been publicly broken since Garcia et al. 2008 and both NXP and the German BSI recommend migration, so new-build rollouts should go directly to DESFire EV3 or NTAG 424 DNA. Proud Tek cross-references the chip against your specific reader brand + model in writing before the artwork is frozen.

faq.question: Is the tag safe for pool, outdoor pet-collar and aquatic-fitness carry?
faq.answer: Specify the fully-domed IP67 variant (epoxy covers front and back) + outdoor-grade formulation + 316L stainless split ring for any chlorine / saltwater / sweat-heavy carry envelope. The standard single-dome variant is IP65 — dust-tight and protected against low-pressure water jets — and is acceptable for rain / hand-wash / sweat exposure but not continuous immersion. For continuous submersion (daily pool / aquatic-fitness / dishwasher) consider the silicone keyfob variant which reaches IP68. The 316L stainless split ring clears EN 1811 nickel release at ≤ 0.5 µg/cm²/week and REACH Annex XVII entry 27, making it safe for skin-contact keychain carry and for chlorine / saltwater exposure that destroys nickel-plated rings inside 2-3 months.

faq.question: Can the same tag carry multiple NFC payloads (URL + vCard + Wi-Fi)?
faq.answer: Yes — {chip:nxp-ntag-216:short_name} (888 bytes) and {chip:nxp-ntag-424-dna:short_name} comfortably carry a multi-record NDEF envelope combining URL + vCard + Wi-Fi handover + Bluetooth pairing + text-record in a single tap. {chip:nxp-ntag-213:short_name} (144 bytes) is limited to 1-2 short records and is better suited to a single URL or short vCard. DESFire EV3 carries application-slot-separated payloads (per NXP AN10922) that are authenticated separately — the same tag can carry a high-security access-control credential in one slot and a phone-tappable loyalty URL in another, without cross-contamination. The NDEF / application-slot plan is frozen before tag production so the encoding bench can run at scale.
